key_facts: Azure 데이터센터에서 **NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72** 시스템이 가동 중
MLPerf Training v6.1에서 Azure가 GB200 NVL72로 **10,240개 GPU** 규모 DeepSeek-V3 학습을 수행, 해당 라운드 최대 규모
MLPerf Inference v6.1에서 Azure GB300 NVL72가 DeepSeek-R1 인터랙티브 처리량에서 클라우드 제출 대비 **10% 이상 우위**(Signal65 기준)
EY가 Microsoft Foundry의 Programmed Training으로 Nemotron 모델을 커스터마이징해 평가 데이터셋 정확도 **55% 개선, 비용 15배 절감**
Azure Local이 NVIDIA Jetson Thor 및 Jetson Orin으로 확장되어 머신비전·로봇공학·자율운영 지원
summary_data.why_matters: NVIDIA가 클라우드 인프라(Vera Rubin NVL72), 엔터프라이즈 모델 커스터마이징(Foundry/Nemotron), 엣지(Jetson), PC(RTX)까지 **AI factory 전구간**을 아우르는 풀스택 협력을 Microsoft와 심화하며 생태계 지배력을 강화하고 있다. MLPerf 벤치마크에서 입증된 하이퍼스케일러와의 긴밀한 코디자인은 경쟁사 대비 NVIDIA의 성능·효율 우위를 뒷받침한다.
summary_data.subject_angle: NVIDIA는 Vera Rubin NVL72부터 Nemotron 오픈 모델, Jetson, RTX PC까지 클라우드-엣지-디바이스 전 구간을 잇는 **풀스택 AI 플랫폼 전략**을 Microsoft와의 공동설계를 통해 구체화하며, 단순 GPU 공급자를 넘어 AI 인프라·소프트웨어 표준을 주도하는 포지션을 강화한다.
summary_data.focus_angle: Azure Local이 **NVIDIA Jetson Thor 및 Jetson Orin** 엣지 AI 플랫폼으로 확장되어 머신비전·로봇공학·자율운영 등 산업용 애플리케이션을 지원하며, physical AI 모델 Cosmos도 Foundry Local에 탑재돼 로봇 개발 역량 강화에 기여한다.

cards.body: NVIDIA and Microsoft are extending their full-stack collaboration to help organizations build, customize and deploy intelligent applications — from next-generation infrastructure on Azure to industrial systems and Windows PCs. At Microsoft Ignite , the companies are expanding access to Azure virtual machines powered by NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems, as well as adding customer availability to NVIDIA open models and customization capabilities through Microsoft Foundry, and new options for running AI at the edge, where businesses generate and use their data. Microsoft is also using NVIDIA technologies to accelerate its own models and services, including NVIDIA Dynamo inference software for post-training and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell GPUs for Bing search models. NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 Running in Azure NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems are running in Azure data centers , providing infrastructure designed for demanding reasoning, agentic applications, and large-scale model training and inference. Microsoft and NVIDIA are also collaborating to extend confidential computing to bare-metal and rack-scale AI infrastructure. The work will help protect sensitive models and data while they are being processed, supporting organizations that need to work with proprietary or regulated information. NVIDIA Confidential Computing and attestation help customers verify the computing environment before releasing sensitive models, data or keys. As AI workloads span more interconnected accelerators, the companies are working to extend those protections across the AI factory infrastructure. To help data centers get more performance from available power, NVIDIA and Microsoft are also collaborating on power efficiency using NVIDIA MaxLPS . Azure’s Vera Rubin preview builds on NVIDIA and Microsoft’s codesign and performance optimization, underscored in the latest NVIDIA Blackwell-based MLPerf results. In MLPerf Training v6.1 , Azure scaled to 10,240 NVIDIA GPUs with GB200 NVL72 systems on the DeepSeek-V3 model, the largest scale in the round. In MLPerf Inference v6.1 , Azure’s NVIDIA GB300 NVL72 systems led cloud submissions on DeepSeek-R1 interactive throughput by over 10%, per Signal65. Helping Enterprises Customize and Deploy Open Models Enterprise AI agents need to reason through complex tasks, find relevant company information and understand business documents. NVIDIA and Microsoft are expanding the models and services available through Microsoft Foundry to help developers bring these capabilities into business applications. Microsoft’s serverless Programmed Training offering gives developers control over post-training workflows while Foundry manages the underlying infrastructure. Enterprises can focus on their business data, evaluating model responses and improving model behavior. action.scope: Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance, Baidu, Tesla(Shanghai) 등 중국 기업 대상 H200 및 동급 AMD 칩

key_facts: BIS가 2026년 5월까지 **87만 9천개 이상의 AI 칩** 수출을 Alibaba, Tencent 등에 승인, 일부는 '중국 군사기업'으로 지정된 곳 포함
2025년 12월~2026년 5월 사이 Nvidia·AMD가 제출한 중국向 AI 칩 판매 요청은 총 340만 개 규모
Nvidia는 해당 분기 H200 등 중국 매출로 **24억 달러**를 기록했으나, China·Hong Kong 고객은 전체 매출의 약 9.5%, H200은 데이터센터 매출의 1% 미만
Nvidia는 라이선스를 일부 획득했음에도 '이후 H200의 중국向 선적을 중단했다'고 밝힘
Rep. Mast는 Nvidia 라이선스 신청서에 등장한 Maginfra·New Matrix 두 업체를 '밀수 위장업체'로 지목
summary_data.why_matters: 이번 공개는 **Jensen Huang의 Nvidia 사임**(중국 스파이 연루 의혹 이후) 직후 나온 것으로, 의회가 초당적으로 대중 AI 칩 수출통제 강화 입법을 추진할 동력을 얻었다는 의미를 갖는다. 다만 애널리스트들은 87만 9천개 승인이 340만개 요청 중 약 25%에 불과하고 실제 매출 비중도 '미미한 수준(rounding error)'이라고 평가해, 정치적 파장과 실질적 매출 영향 사이에 간극이 있다.
summary_data.subject_angle: Nvidia는 **당시 유효했던 Commerce 규정을 준수했다**는 입장을 유지하며, 라이선스 획득에도 불구하고 실제로는 H200의 중국 선적을 자발적으로 중단한 점을 강조해 규제 리스크와 지정학적 평판 리스크를 관리하려는 전략을 보인다.

cards.body: The subagency of the Commerce Department that regulates and enforces exports approved the sale of more than 879,000 AI chips to Chinese companies including Alibaba and Tencent as of May 2026, according to documents released Thursday by the House Foreign Affairs Committee. Some of those approvals, made by Commerce's Bureau of Industry and Security, included sales to companies designated by the Department of Defense as "Chinese Military Companies," according to the documents. From December through May, companies had made 3.4 million requests for sales of U.S. AI chips to China, the committee reported, citing those made by Nvidia and Advanced Micro Devices. "Over the past month, the administration's handling of chip export controls has put our national security and technology edge at risk. The Bureau of Industry and Security has failed to enforce the rules, and Congress must now conduct rigorous oversight of the administration's policies," Rep. Gregory Meeks, D-N.Y., the top Democrat on the House Foreign Affairs Committee, said at a meeting of the panel Thursday at which members voted to release the documents. Spokespersons for Nvidia and AMD said their companies comply with U.S. export control laws. Nvidia argued it was following the Commerce Department regulations that were in effect at the time. A spokesperson from the Bureau of Industry and Security said it shared information with Congress on both approvals and denials of licenses for Nvidia's H200 and comparable chips. "Licensing decisions are the product of deliberation and consultation among multiple U.S. Government agencies," the spokesperson said. "The review and licensing process spanned more than half a year, with approvals subject to strict conditions and limited volumes. Despite receiving some licenses, we have since stopped shipping H200s to China," Nvidia spokesperson John Rizzo told CNBC. On Tuesday, Nvidia reported $2.4 billion in quarterly revenue from H200 and related chip sales in China. In total, customers based in China and Hong Kong made up about 9.5% of all revenue. "AMD complies with applicable U.S. export control laws and regulations and maintains rigorous processes to ensure compliance across our global operations," AMD said through a spokesperson. The approval of 879,000 AI chips is "not that many," Bernstein Senior Analyst Stacy Rasgon told CNBC, adding that this news is not surprising. "It doesn't sound to me like they're approving everything they got willy nilly," Rasgon said of the Commerce Department. With 879,000 approvals out of 3.4 million requested AI chip sales, he added, "There was a process in place, and it sounds like they approved about one out of every four." Despite a rapid succession of China export controls on AI chips that started under the Biden administration in 2022, Nvidia and AMD both re-engineered some chips to comply and be sold legally in China. NVIDIA는 2026년 11월 17일 분기 실적에서 매출 1,158억 달러(전년 대비 103% 증가)를 기록, 2028 회계연도 전망 상향 예정

Huang과의 관계가 의심되는 Megaspeed 임원 Alice Huang은 중국 스파이로 미 당국이 의심하고 있음
summary_data.why_matters: NVIDIA 창업자이자 상징적 리더의 갑작스러운 사퇴와 중국 스파이 연루설은 **미중 AI 기술 패권 경쟁**의 민감한 시점에서 지정학적 리스크로 번질 수 있다. 동시에 H200 대중국 수출 중단 결정은 미국의 첨단 칩 수출 통제 정책 강화와 직결되며 NVIDIA의 중국 매출 전략에 변화를 예고한다.
summary_data.subject_angle: 리더십 공백에도 불구하고 **매출 103% 성장**이라는 강력한 실적으로 사업 연속성을 입증했으나, 창업자 복귀 요구와 이사회의 거부 입장이 충돌하며 향후 거버넌스 불확실성이 남아있다.

cards.body: Nvidia co-founder and now former CEO Jensen Huang has never been as prone to controversy as AI leaders like OpenAI’s Sam Altman or SpaceXAI’s Elon Musk. But the 63-year-old industry kingpin recently admitted that he cheated on his wife of 40 years in affairs that could have ramifications beyond Huang’s personal life and U.S. national security. U.S. officials believe that one of Huang’s likely romantic interests, Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, is a Chinese spy who has been feeding information back to Beijing. (Alice Huang, a Chinese citizen, is of no relation to Jensen Huang.) Megaspeed is a Singapore-based AI infrastructure company that reportedly purchased $4.8 billion worth of Nvidia chips over the last two years. The U.S. and Singapore have both previously investigated Megaspeed over suspicions that the firm was illegally sharing chips with China. The Justice Department has since taken over the federal investigation into the company, The New York Times has reported. The story took a sudden turn on Wednesday. Citing five people who worked at Nvidia, the Times reported that Huang also had an extramarital relationship with Kimberly Powell, the company’s vice president of healthcare, who reports directly to him. Nvidia, Huang and Powell have not confirmed the report. Reached by a Times reporter, Huang reportedly said, “I don’t think you should be talking to me directly,” before hanging up. By early Thursday morning, Huang was no longer CEO of the company he co-founded 33 years ago. Then, Thursday afternoon, Reuters dropped another bombshell, publishing a report alleging that Huang had yet another extramarital affair with another unnamed Nvidia employee. The U.S. and China are embroiled in a fierce technological arms race to build the most advanced AI infrastructure, which could shape each country’s economic future, military prowess, and capacity for innovation. Nvidia is valuable in this competition as one of the world’s largest makers of AI chips, which are essential for accelerating AI development. But as an American company, Nvidia faces government restrictions on the sale of its most powerful chips to Chinese entities. As the controversy unfolds, we are organizing the most relevant events into a reverse-chronological timeline to keep you up to date. November 17, 2026: Nvidia posts strong quarterly earnings, says it does not plan to reinstate Huang Nvidia reported its quarterly earnings on Tuesday, which beat Wall Street expectations with $115.8 billion in revenue, up 103% year-over-year. Despite the unknowns the company faces without Huang involved, interim CEO Colette Kress said that full-year revenue is also on track to exceed expectations. action.scope: 삼성전자·SK하이닉스 D램·낸드(기업용 SSD) 가격 및 공급, 글로벌 메모리 시장

key_facts: 내년 글로벌 D램 수요는 올해보다 **25% 증가**, 공급 증가율은 18%에 그쳐 공급 충족률 70% 수준 전망
삼성전자·SK하이닉스의 내년 D램 계약가격 **ASP 40% 상승** 전망, 낸드 ASP도 30% 상승 전망
내년 서버용 D램 수요 56%, 기업용 SSD 수요 54% 증가 전망, 양사 기업용 SSD 매출 비중 65% 이상(샌디스크·키옥시아는 30~40%)
최근 한 달간 D램·낸드 현물가격은 각각 5%, 20% 하락했으나 계약가격은 상승세 지속, 11월 현재 현물-계약가격 괴리 20% 이상
최근 반도체주 급락 배경으로 **엔비디아 리더십 변화 가능성**과 미국 민주당의 AI 규제 기조가 지목됨
summary_data.why_matters: AI 데이터센터 투자 확대로 서버용 D램·기업용 SSD 수요가 공급을 크게 상회하면서 메모리 가격 상승이 구조적 현상으로 자리잡고 있으며, 이는 **AI 인프라 투자의 지속성**을 뒷받침하는 신호로 해석된다. 동시에 엔비디아의 리더십 변화 가능성이 반도체 공급망 전반의 투자심리에 영향을 미칠 만큼 엔비디아의 시장 영향력이 크다는 점도 드러났다.
summary_data.subject_angle: 메모리 가격 상승은 **AI GPU 수요 확대**와 직결된 서버·데이터센터 투자 증가를 반영하는 지표로, 엔비디아 생태계(HBM·고용량 SSD 등 부품 수급)의 지속성과 비용 구조에 영향을 줄 수 있다. 또한 엔비디아 리더십 이슈가 반도체주 전반의 투자심리를 흔들었다는 점은 엔비디아의 시장 신뢰도가 공급망 밸류체인 전체에 미치는 파급력을 보여준다.

cards.body: D램 계약가격 40% 상승 전망 내년 글로벌 D램 공급 부족이 심화하면서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 D램 평균판매가격(ASP)이 올해보다 40% 상승할 것이라는 전망이 나왔다. 최근 메모리 현물가격 하락으로 반도체 업황에 대한 우려가 커지고 있지만, 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터발 수요가 공급을 웃돌면서 실제 기업 실적은 견조한 흐름을 이어갈 것이라는 분석이다. 20일 KB증권에 따르면 내년 글로벌 D램 수요는 올해보다 25% 증가하는 반면 공급 증가율은 18%에 그칠 것으로 예상된다. AI 데이터센터 투자 확대에 따른 서버용 D램 수요가 급증하면서 공급 부족이 올해보다 심화할 것이라는 전망이다. 이에 따라 주요 고객사의 D램 공급 충족률은 필요한 물량의 70% 수준에 머물 것으로 추정됐다. 공급 부족이 지속되면서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 내년 D램 평균판매가격은 계약가격 기준 올해보다 40% 상승할 것으로 전망됐다. 낸드플래시 역시 기업용 솔리드스테이트드라이브(SSD)를 중심으로 가격 상승세가 이어질 것으로 예상됐다. 내년 글로벌 낸드 수요 증가율은 19%로 공급 증가율과 대체로 균형을 이루겠지만, 기업용 SSD 수요가 소비자용 제품의 부진을 상쇄할 것이라는 분석이다. 특히 기업용 SSD 매출 비중에서 삼성전자와 SK하이닉스가 경쟁사보다 앞서 있다는 점도 긍정적인 요인으로 꼽혔다. 양사의 기업용 SSD 매출 비중은 65%를 웃도는 반면 샌디스크와 키옥시아는 30~40% 수준이다. 이에 따라 AI 데이터센터의 저장장치 수요 확대에 따른 수혜가 국내 반도체 업체에 집중될 수 있다는 설명이다. KB증권은 양사의 내년 낸드 평균판매가격도 올해보다 30% 상승할 것으로 내다봤다. 최근 메모리 현물가격 하락이 업황 악화의 신호라는 시장의 우려에 대해서는 과도한 해석이라는 평가를 내놨다. 최근 한 달간 D램과 낸드 현물가격은 각각 5%, 20% 하락했지만, 반도체 업체의 실적에 직접적인 영향을 미치는 계약가격은 오히려 상승세를 이어가고 있기 때문이다. 김동원 KB증권 리서치본부장은 “현물가격은 스마트폰과 PC 등 소비자용 제품의 수요 부진을 즉각 반영하지만 서버용 D램과 기업용 SSD 등 AI 메모리 수요는 충분히 반영하지 못한다”며 “11월 현재 현물가격과 계약가격의 괴리는 20% 이상으로 확대됐다”고 설명했다. 이어 “내년 서버용 D램과 기업용 SSD 수요는 각각 56%, 54% 증가할 것으로 전망된다”며 “현물가격과 계약가격의 괴리는 일시적인 현상이 아닌 구조적인 차이”라고 강조했다. 최근 반도체주 급락의 배경으로는 엔비디아의 리더십 변화 가능성과 미국 민주당의 AI 규제 기조 등 대외 불확실성이 지목됐다. 여기에 메모리 현물가격 하락까지 겹치면서 투자심리가 위축됐다는 분석이다. 김 본부장은 “삼성전자와 SK하이닉스의 실적을 좌우하는 것은 현물가격이 아닌 계약가격”이라며 “대외 변수에 대한 과도한 우려가 이미 주가에 상당 부분 반영된 만큼 양사에 대한 시장의 비관론은 정점에 근접한 것으로 판단한다”고 밝혔다. 이상목 기자 mrlsm@etnews.com

headlines.body: Turning a simulation idea into a working application means assembling assets, connecting physics and rendering, and checking that the scene behaves as intended. Developers are combining frontier AI models with NVIDIA Omniverse libraries to help carry out that work — building applications for exploring scenarios, investigating failures and improving designs. Developers direct AI agents through natural-language instructions, review results and guide changes. Omniverse libraries provide GPU-accelerated physics, rendering and sensor simulation capabilities. Explore the projects below to see frontier AI models such as GPT-6 Astra at work, and check back for new examples from NVIDIA teams and developers across the ecosystem. Physical AI Paves the Path to Autonomous Industrial Operations https://blogs.nvidia.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Nyhamna_footage_take5_30s.mp4 AI agents powered by frontier models pave the way to autonomous operations. They use industrial tools and engineering data to help engineers build digital twins that test plans and processes and evaluate operational decisions. Falkor, a KONGSBERG company, shows how this works in practice. The company’s Falkor Surface platform lets customers turn their computer-aided design and engineering data into facility-scale digital twins using the GPT-6 Astra model. The platform uses NVIDIA Omniverse libraries and NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Server Edition GPUs on Microsoft Azure to enable advanced physics simulation. AI agents built on Falkor’s agentic engine understand dense technical documentation, spatial relationships and real-world physics. Engineers can create and test plans in simulation before traveling on site, reducing costly delays and mistakes. They can also inspect equipment and check clearances in a shared view. Read Falkor’s article and watch the livestream f or a closer look at how the company builds these tools and checks the agents’ work. Build a Robot Pick-and-Place Simulation With SimReady Assets Getting a robot model into a scene is only the start. Developers also need to assemble its components, add controls and check whether it can complete a task. NVIDIA developers Dillon Bailey and Rishabh Chadha used 3D assets from the SimReady Central library to build a pick-and-place simulation of a robot moving a can using the NVIDIA Isaac Sim framework. They directed an agent equipped with GPT-6 Sol and Isaac Sim skills to assemble the scene and generate pick-and-place controls. Testing the assembled scene shows how the assets work together, from joint movement and contact behavior to the gripper’s ability to hold, move and release the can. With that baseline in place, developers can adjust object positions and motion paths and repeat the tests to evaluate how each change affects the task. Follow the walkthrough to assemble and test a pick-and-place simulation in Isaac Sim, with sample agent prompts and checks for robot movement and grasp behavior. headlines.body: The AI data center build-out is pushing electricity grids across the globe, with many regions facing demand from projects that would exceed the current peak load that each system could support. According to the International Energy Agency’s (IEA) World Energy Outlook 2026 report , a total of 120GW of capacity is currently available across all types of data centers across the globe, with another 120GW expected to be completed by the end of the decade, 75% of which would be dedicated to artificial intelligence. Aside from that, it’s also tracking 93 large “AI factories” that are either under construction or being expanded via satellite imagery. It estimates that the capacity for these sites grew from under 2GW to 17GW in just two years, and that they’re expected to hit a total of 50GW upon completion, the equivalent of adding a second Great Britain to power demand. However, the IEA says that its analysis “does not yet show a clear relationship between growth in data center capacity and increases in electricity prices.” It noted that if a data center uses existing capacity and pays for its share of the cost, then it could potentially lead to lower utility bills for all customers. However, if the grid operator is required to upgrade its system to accommodate the large consumer, then it could also lead to increased monthly bills if the costs are spread across all users. Emissions are another issue that the IEA has raised. Renewable energy dominates data centers’ power purchase agreements at nearly 50%, but actual power generation puts coal- and natural-gas power sources closer to 60%. This is likely due to the need for reliability, with the latter kicking in when the former cannot deliver the power that the data center needs. Aside from that, a few projects are deploying their own power, like Elon Musk’s Colossus 2 in Southaven, Mississippi , with about 180GW planned or under construction in the U.S. So, even though renewable energy is growing to accommodate demand, it’s also expected that coal- and natural-gas emissions from data centers will rise by 70% by 2030. Investments in AI data centers are expected to hit $32 trillion by 2050, putting the infrastructure spending for the industry larger than railways, electrification, and the internet, combined. headlines.title: Musk says Jensen Huang is irreplaceable, regrets midterm spending

stage1.korean_title: 일론 머스크, Jensen Huang 사임을 'Michael Jordan 제외'에 비유하며 비판
stage1.korean_summary: Elon Musk가 Jensen Huang의 NVIDIA 사임을 팀 약화로 강하게 비판했으며, Huang의 국회 증언과 함께 NVIDIA의 경영 공백이 주목되고 있다.

headlines.body: Elon Musk compared Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia to kicking Michael Jordan off a team on a winning streak, while also expressing regret over how much he spent on the U.S. midterms. "You've got a winning streak ... and then you kick Michael Jordan off your team," Musk told Andrew Ross Sorkin at The New York Times' DealBook Summit on Wednesday. He added, "Doesn't seem like a smart decision to me." Huang resigned last week following pressure after disclosing an affair with a woman who reportedly was suspected of being a Chinese spy, alongside reports of relationships with employees. He is expected to testify before the U.S. Congress next month around national-security and export-control issues. The SpaceX and Tesla chief executive, who previously said it would be an "honor" to hire the Nvidia co-founder, added that no one could really replace Huang. Musk said he had heard similar views about Huang's departure from Nvidia, including from President Donald Trump. "I think the president has voiced publicly that he thinks Jensen should have stayed as CEO, and everyone I know thinks the same ... this is, at the end of the day, the Nvidia board decision," he said, adding, "We're not on the board, right?" Musk and Huang have known each other for years through Nvidia's work with Tesla and OpenAI. Tesla has been a major Nvidia customer, while Huang has repeatedly praised Musk's AI strategy, including Tesla's self-driving work, xAI and the Optimus robot. Midterms, Tesla and SpaceX Asked about the midterms, Musk said he felt "pretty foolish" about spending at least $474 million with little to show for it, though he added that "maybe it would have been much worse without that." Musk said his goal had been to prevent the presidency, House and Senate from all being controlled by one party. "If I could rewind the clock, I would have spent less money," he said. In the same interview, he also appeared to distance himself from the MAGA movement. "I'm not MAGA," he said, adding that he wasn't sure what the term means. On a possible SpaceX-Tesla merger, Musk said areas of overlap now exist that "didn't exist before," pointing to AI, robotics and the AI software and chip-design teams at both companies. He said any deal would require shareholder approval and "may or may not succeed." Musk added that he could not push through a transaction that was bad for shareholders because he would "obviously get sued." Asked whether he should receive his Tesla pay award if a merger were completed, Musk said he should not be rewarded "just for doing a merger" and should receive stock-option awards only if Tesla meets its performance targets. Musk also said SpaceX rents computing capacity to Anthropic under short-term agreements that either side can terminate, adding that the Claude AI chatbot-maker had expressed interest in an additional 10 gigawatts. README:  # Model Overview Nemotron-Labs-Audio-Visual Flamingo: Open Audio-Visual Intelligence for Long and Complex Videos Nemotron-Labs-Audio-Visual Flamingo (AVF) is a fully open audio-visual large language model for joint understanding and reasoning over audio, images, and videos. `nvidia/nemotron-labs-audio-visual-flamingo-hf` is the instruction-tuned checkpoint for multimodal understanding and text generation over long, complex, real-world videos. AVF is designed for settings where the answer depends on both what is visible and what is audible: speech, background sounds, music, visual actions, scene transitions, temporal order, and cross-modal alignment. This checkpoint generates text only; streaming TTS is not included in the Hub weights. **This model is for non-commercial research purposes only.** ## Description AVF extends the Audio Flamingo line from audio-only understanding into joint audio-visual reasoning. The model combines: - a SigLIP vision tower for images and sampled video frames - Dynamic-S2 visual preprocessing for high-resolution images and long videos - an AF-Whisper audio encoder for speech, sound, and music - separate 2-layer projectors for visual and audio features - temporal audio-visual interleaving with Constrained Rotary Time Embeddings (CRTE) - a Qwen2.5-7B-family decoder-only language backbone Unlike systems that process video frames and audio as independent streams, AVF aligns synchronized visual and audio chunks, interleaves them along the time axis, an

README:  # **🦜 Parakeet TDT 0.6B V2 (En)** img { display: inline; } [ ](#model-architecture) | [ ](#model-architecture) | [ ](#datasets) > **🎉 NEW: Multilingual Parakeet TDT 0.6B V3 is now available!** > 🌍 **25 European Languages** | 🚀 **Enhanced Performance** | 🔗 **[Try it here: nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3](https://huggingface.co/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3)** ## Description: `parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2` is a 600-million-parameter automatic speech recognition (ASR) model designed for high-quality English transcription, featuring support for punctuation, capitalization, and accurate timestamp prediction. Try Demo here: https://huggingface.co/spaces/nvidia/parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 This XL variant of the FastConformer [1] architecture integrates the TDT [2] decoder and is trained with full attention, enabling efficient transcription of audio segments up to 24 minutes in a single pass. The model achieves an RTFx of 3380 on the HF-Open-ASR leaderboard with a batch size of 128. Note: *RTFx Performance may vary depending on dataset audio duration and batch size.* **Key Features** - Accurate word-level timestamp predictions - Automatic punctuation and capitalization - Robust performance on spoken numbers, and song lyrics transcription For more information, refer to the [Model Architecture](#model-architecture) section and the [NeMo documentation](https://docs.nvidia.com/deeplearning/nemo/user-guide/docs/en/main/asr/models.html#fast-conformer). This model is ready for commercial/non-commercial use. ##
